title: Of Kings and Prophets
premise_summary: Of Kings and Prophets is an American television drama based on the Biblical Books of Samuel that premiered on ABC in 2016. The series follows an ensemble of characters including Saul and David, the successive kings of Israel, their families, and their political rivals. Of Kings and Prophets was filmed in Cape Town, South Africa.
